m01.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram for Reusable Android CLI agent skills and device streaming: A layered mobile-automation workshop: a reusable skill capsule library feeds a single CLI command rail, which orchestrates a device-state cutaway, a live screen stream, bounded test actions, and signed result evidence returning to the skill library.

m02.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram for Backend-state verification for agents: A forensic split-plane architecture contrasts an upper claim channel with a lower durable-state channel; database records, side-effect receipts, and repeated-run samples converge through a verification tribunal into an immutable evidence ledger.

m10.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram for Prompt-driven synchronized knowledge work across images, canvases, and applications: A shared-source data spine feeds three visually distinct workbenches—object-level image editing, a prompt-built spreadsheet canvas, and cross-application execution—while provenance and synchronization rails reconcile changes into a review surface.

m11.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram for Citation-grounded scientific report generation: A research question enters a retrieval observatory; source fragments pass through relevance and support filters into a citation lattice, then a report composer emits claim blocks whose trace lines terminate at the exact supporting fragments and an independent verification panel.

m12.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram for Bounded desktop computer use through an observe-plan-act loop: A user-intent capsule enters a command console; an observe-plan-act control loop traverses multiple abstract desktop applications, pauses at confirmation gates for consequential actions, and writes each step into an audit trail.

m14.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram for Event-driven ambient agents with human approval and resumable state: An event bus opens an isolated session containing a durable job-state core; policy and confidence gates route steps either to bounded tool execution or an approval interrupt, after which the exact state resumes and closes with a complete audit trail.
